summary: Pixel bar chart whose bars grow cell by cell and spring to new data; hover or the arrow keys show exact values in a tooltip.

props.name: data
props.description: The bars, left to right: `{ label: string; value: number }`. Bars spring to new values when it changes. Negative and non-finite values draw an empty bar.

props.name: max
props.description: Top of the value axis. With 0 the axis tops out at 110% of the largest value.

props.name: label
props.description: Start of the canvas `aria-label`, followed by every label and value.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit shown after each value in the tooltip and the `aria-label`, separated by a space.

keyboard.action: Highlight the next / previous bar and show its tooltip, wrapping.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"`, `tabindex="0"` and an `aria-label` listing every label and value, for example "Runs per day: Mon 12 runs, Tue 18 runs, …".
The tooltip is visual only and is not announced; losing focus or the pointer hides it.
motion: With reduced motion bars appear at their final height without the staggered spring.
notes: The sample data Mon 12, Tue 18, Wed 9, Thu 22, Fri 17, Sat 6, Sun 4 is drawn when `data` is not set.
On first view the bars grow in one after another, 50 ms apart; bars added later spring up at once.
The value axis has five gridlines labelled from 0 to the axis maximum, in the monospace font.

data.note: Pass your bars as `data`. Without it the chart shows a sample week of seven invented values.
